title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
contentSnippet: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services
contentSnippet: Try Amazon ECS Gateway, a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.

title: Introducing tsrs: a Port of TypeScript to Rust
contentSnippet: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
contentSnippet: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
